brief: AI strategy and agent adoption roadmap with risk register and board-style presentation.

milestones.name: Scope and baseline
milestones.deliverable: Boundary, data card, baseline and success criteria.

milestones.name: Prototype and controls
milestones.deliverable: Runnable or visual prototype, source log and approval path.

milestones.name: Evaluation and peer review
milestones.deliverable: Held-out cases, failures, peer critique and revisions.

milestones.name: Defense and handover
milestones.deliverable: Five-minute evidence demo, five-minute questions, runbook and limitations.

bands.Exemplary: Full points: reproducible evidence, justified choices, limitations addressed.
bands.Proficient: 75% of points: core requirement met; minor evidence gaps.
bands.Developing: 50% of points: partial implementation or weak justification.
bands.Insufficient: 0 points: missing evidence or unsafe result.

exemplar: A fictional approval queue retains missing scores, routes uncertainty to review and never executes updates. Its evidence pack records input versions, thresholds, subgroup counts, failed cases and a rollback owner. Adapt this scaffold to the program brief. This is not a finished capstone solution.
peerReview: A peer challenges an unsupported claim and repeats one test; the author documents the response.
status: Draft brief; finished program-specific exemplars require SME authoring.
